verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Reflect is a markdown-based, keyboard-driven note editor with linking shortcuts ([[ ]]) and an AI palette invoked via cmd+j, implying rich text editing, but there is no explicit mention of headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, or embedded media support in the editor itself.  missing for 10: explicit documentation of headings/callouts/tables/code-block formatting, embedded media/image handling, and independent hands-on confirmation of editing speed/power-user workflow.
